errors.generic: That did not work. Your entries are still here; try again.
errors.notAllowed: Only the person with this provider profile can edit it.
errors.notEditable: Your profile is submitted or suspended and cannot be edited right now.
errors.regionsTooMany: Choose no more than ten regions.
errors.invalidRegion: A region you chose is no longer approved. Choose your regions again.
errors.displayNameTooShort: The display name needs at least 2 characters.
errors.displayNameTooLong: The display name can have no more than 60 characters.
errors.descriptionTooShort: The description needs at least 50 characters.
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description can have no more than 4000 characters.
errors.languagesTooMany: Choose no more than eight languages.
errors.durationTooShort: The duration must be at least 15 minutes.
errors.durationTooLong: The duration can be no more than 24 hours.
errors.priceTooLow: Enter a price of at least 1 franc.
errors.priceTooHigh: The price can be no more than 100,000 francs.
errors.priceInvalid: Enter the price as a whole number in francs.
errors.noteTooLong: The note can have no more than 120 characters.
errors.ratesTooMany: You can enter no more than 12 rates.
errors.providerNotConfigured: The check is not available yet. Your profile stays saved as a draft.
errors.incomplete: Your profile is not complete yet. Complete the steps in the list.
errors.publicationConsentRequired: Please agree to publication so that we can review the profile.

review.title: Your profile was returned for corrections
review.intro: The review team asks you to make changes in these steps. Then submit the profile again.

access.suspendedText: You cannot edit or submit it at the moment. Support can help you.
access.underAge: The identity check showed that you are not of legal age. Profiles of minors are not allowed on the platform, so your profile is suspended.

state.slow: Loading is taking longer than usual.
state.errorTitle: This step could not be loaded
state.errorDescription: Everything you already saved is kept.

identity.explainer: The check runs at the verification provider: ID document, legal age and a short liveness test with the camera. The platform only stores the result, the time and the expiry date, never a copy of your ID.
identity.noneText: Have your ID document ready. Afterwards you come back here.
identity.pendingText: Finish the check at the provider. If you get stuck there, start it again.
identity.validText: Valid until {date}. Verify again before it expires.
identity.expiredText: The check expired on {date}. Without a valid check your profile is not public.
identity.expiredTextNoDate: The check is no longer valid. Without a valid check your profile is not public.

reasons.under-age: The check showed that you are not of legal age.
reasons.not-verified: The provider could not confirm your identity.
reasons.document-unreadable: The ID document could not be read. Make sure it is well lit and fully in the picture.
reasons.liveness-failed: The liveness test did not succeed. Use good light and look straight into the camera.

identity.unavailableTitle: The check is not available yet
identity.unavailableText: The verification provider is not connected yet. You can fill in all other steps; you can only submit your profile after a passed check.

verification.title: Verification
verification.intro: A passed check is valid for twelve months. When it expires, your profile is no longer public until you verify again.

regions.intro: Choose where visitors should find you: at least one, no more than ten regions.
regions.privacy: Your exact address is never published. Your profile names the region as broadly as you choose it, so a canton or a city.
regions.count: {count, plural, =0 {No region chosen} one {# region chosen} other {# regions chosen}}, up to 10
regions.empty: No regions are approved yet. As soon as there are some, you choose them here.

profile.intro: Your display name and your description appear in the marketplace.
profile.displayNameHint: This is how you appear in the marketplace, 2 to 60 characters.
profile.descriptionHint: At least 50 characters. Describe what visitors can expect from you.
profile.languagesHint: The languages in which you arrange appointments, up to eight.

media.text: You will soon upload photos in the media library in Studio. You can skip this step now and add photos later.
media.neutral: Without photos your profile shows a neutral area with your initials.

offer.intro: Name your rates by duration. Visitors see them as a table in your profile.
offer.empty: No rates yet. Without rates your profile shows «Rates on request».
offer.max: You have reached the maximum of 12 rates.
offer.servicesText: You choose services as soon as the categories are maintained. Until then your offer consists of rates.

availability.text: You will soon maintain working hours and absences in the Studio calendar. You can skip this step now.
availability.neutral: Without maintained availability your profile shows no section about it.

preview.intro: This is how visitors would see your profile.
preview.note: The full profile page follows later and uses the same building blocks as this preview.
preview.heading: How visitors see your profile
preview.trustEmpty: No trust signals yet. «Identity verified» appears as soon as your check has passed.
preview.identityChecked: Legal age and identity with ID document and liveness test, at the verification provider.
preview.identityNotImplied: The signal says nothing about services, quality or safety.

submit.intro: We review submitted profiles by hand. Your profile only becomes public after approval.
submit.ready: Everything is ready. You can submit your profile.
submit.consent: I agree to this profile being published.
submit.consentHint: The profile only becomes visible after our review. You can pause it at any time or withdraw your consent by archiving the profile.
